What does India bring to the BRICS grouping? As the bloc expands, New Delhi is positioning itself as a bridge between countries with diverse interests. From its large economy and Global South focus to UPI, digital public infrastructure, fintech and its role in the New Development Bank, India brings significant economic and technological strengths to BRICS.
The video also explores India’s ties with Russia, China and the US, along with its focus on development finance, technology and institutional reform. Hem Saroya tells you more on Vantage on Firstpost.
